messages:
Nina: Quick thread re: dark console theming — small set of UX nits from the QA pass. Charts, code snippets, and the theme label stood out. Posting mock concerns here.
Owen: Saw the QA notes. For charts: the stacked area colors blend too much at small widths. We should increase relative contrast between adjacent series, not just saturation. Maybe introduce slight hue shifts plus a tiny outline.
Priya: On the code snippets: inline code uses #6CE3FF which is bright on dark bg. Suggest move identifiers to a desaturated teal (hsl(175 60% 66%)) and reserve bright cyan for links only. Keep background gutters at 1:8 contrast.
Liam: Accessibility point: the chart axis ticks are 11px and use #98A2AE on #0C0F12 — thats borderline. Either text size up to 12/13px or color to #BFC9D1. Also ensure focus ring on interactive legends meets 3:1 at minimum.
Nina: Copy tweak: current toggle says "Dim Mode"  which confuses new hires. Recommend explicit "Appearance: Light / Dark" and add aria-label for screen readers: "Toggle appearance to light or dark mode".
Owen: Regarding heatmaps, we prototyped a luminance-first ramp (lightness only) so ordering is preserved under colorblind filters. Works well but feels flat visually. Could we add a subtle chroma gradient on top for visual richness while keeping L the primary signal?
Priya: Yes to luminance-first. Also add a 1px separator on heatmap cells and test on retina / non-retina to ensure crispness.
Liam: UX test plan: 1) run Lighthouse contrast audits, 2) do a 5-user blind color test (deutan/protan), 3) measure canvas paints on low-end devices. If any chart style causes >10ms extra paint per interaction, don't ship.
design-bot: Created ticket DGN-8284 with mocks and links: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/console-theme-ux (internal).
Nina: I updated the Figma with two variants: "Luminance Ramp + Chroma" and "Muted Teal Syntax". Scheduling quick 20-min sync Friday for pick. Thanks all :raised_hands:
